definitions.gloss: fishing with a rod and line
definitions.explanation: Catching fish with a rod, line and hook, usually as a pastime. It is the plain, everyday word; children and casual speakers use it more than the bare {釣|つ}り.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{魚釣|さかなつ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went fishing with my father.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{魚釣|さかなつ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During summer vacation I went fishing in the river.

examples.japanese: {魚釣|さかなつ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Fishing involves a lot of waiting, but that is part of the fun.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魚釣|さかなつ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go fishing
- {魚釣|さかなつ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fish
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魚釣|さかなつ}り: sea fishing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧: fishing; the usual word among anglers and in compounds (⟦{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}→釣り竿：07331_tsurizao⟧, {海釣|うみづ}り). {魚釣|さかなつ}り spells out what is being caught and sounds homelier.
